question: How many people can play?
answer: 2–10 friends. A game runs 6–12 rounds, so there’s room for everyone to write more than once.

question: Do we need to be in the same room?
answer: No, you can play with friends who are somewhere else too, as long as everyone plays at the same time. But it’s made for being together: a party or an evening in, ending with the story read out loud. There are no notifications on purpose. Everyone plays at once, phones in hand.

question: Do we need to download an app?
answer: No. Unfolded runs in the browser on any phone. Friends join with a link or a 4-digit room code.

question: Can I see what the others wrote?
answer: Not until the end. That’s the fun. On your turn, you only see the start of the sentence the last player left you. If you forget what you wrote yourself, Peek lets you look under your fold for a moment.

question: What if someone takes too long?
answer: You get 3 minutes to finish your sentence and 2 to start the next. In the final 30 seconds everyone sees a last call, and if time runs out, the turn passes on, so the story keeps moving.

question: Do I need an account?
answer: No, you can play without one, but then your finished stories disappear after a week. With an account (just a name and email), they’re saved to your profile.

question: Can I share a finished story?
answer: Yes. When the game ends, tap “Share the story” to send a picture of the finished page, signatures and all, to WhatsApp or anywhere else, or save it to your phone. Your stories are also saved to your profile.
